text: The clinic feels safe, the doctor is skilled and gentle, and the staff are friendly and provide excellent service.
The service was good, and the staff were attentive. The doctor gave good advice.

DO NOT, DO NOT, Do NOT go to Meridian Clinic! They injected my cheeks with too much corticoid and destroyed the collagen producing cells. My face is thin and flabby now and I look 10 years older. I thought the dermatologists back in the States can fix it but they say the damage is permanent and they can't fix it. I went to this place in Chiang Mai because the price was so much cheaper than in the States, but I so regret it now. Avoid Thai dermatologists in Chiang Mai. They are nice and smile at you but they are NOT qualified. If only someone else had warned me...
